items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: I mean I knew Rudy Vallée.

ctx.x: Oh. You’d just get a sub?

Yeah. So anyway we started with “Bye Bye Birdie.” And we did that for about a year, it was a big hit, and then he says, “we’re going to change shows.” I said, “what do you want to do that for?” It was a big hit. “No I’m going to change shows.” I said, “what are you going to do?” He said, “well we’ve got this guy, Rudy Vallée and he threw out a bunch of names I never heard of, and I said, “what the heck’s the name of the show?” He said, “How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying.” I said, “how are you going…
